title: The 31 Best Deals From the REI Labor Day Sale
gist: A WIRED shopping roundup of REI's 2026 Labor Day Sale (August 28 to September 7), highlighting discounts of up to 40% on outdoor gear from REI's house brand and other brands like Mountain Hardwear, Nemo, Big Agnes, and Coleman, plus competing deals from Backcountry and Amazon.

themes.theme: REI Labor Day sale scope and structure

insights.claim: REI's 2026 Labor Day Sale runs from August 28 to Labor Day, September 7, with many items discounted up to 40 percent, and REI Co-op members getting up to an additional 20 percent off any REI Outlet item.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Consumer spending / retail signal: indicates the scale and duration of REI's seasonal promotional push, a data point on outdoor-retail discounting patterns around the Labor Day shopping period.
insights.quote: This year’s event kicks off on August 28 and ends on Labor Day, September 7. Many items are up to 40 percent off, and REI Co-op members save up to 20 percent on any REI Outlet item.

insights.claim: The best-value deal highlighted is the REI Co-op Half Dome 2 Tent With Footprint, discounted to $198 (a $131 reduction), described as the best budget two-person backpacking tent.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Consumer spending / retail signal: a flagship promotional price point REI is using to draw shoppers into the sale.
insights.quote: REI Co-op Half Dome 2 Tent With Footprint for $198 ($131 off)

insights.claim: The Mountain Hardwear Ghost Whisperer Down Hoody, described as the writer's top pick for a backpacking puffer jacket, was discounted to $199 (a $200 reduction), though limited to one color with sizes running out.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Consumer spending / retail signal: one of the steepest percentage discounts in the roundup, illustrating how deep outdoor apparel markdowns can go during Labor Day clearance events.
insights.quote: This deal is limited to one color, with sizes disappearing fast, but it's a pretty outstanding deal.

insights.claim: Beyond REI's own house brand, the sale roundup features discounted gear from brands including Mountain Hardwear, Nemo Equipment, Big Agnes, Coleman, MSR, Jetboil, Smartwool, Fjällräven, Kelty, Sea to Summit, Insta360, and Garmin, with some deals pulled from competing retailers Backcountry and Amazon.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Consumer spending / retail signal: shows the breadth of outdoor-gear brands participating in or being cross-shopped during this seasonal sale window across multiple retail channels.
insights.quote: there are also good discounts on other brands, like Mountain Hardwear, Nemo Equipment, Big Agnes, and Coleman, among others. I’ve also pulled some deals from competing sales at Backcountry and other cottage industry retailers.

insights.claim: REI's house-brand strategy is characterized in the piece as delivering roughly 90 percent of the quality of designer competitor items for about 70 percent of the price.
insights.speaker: Scott Gilbertson
insights.so_what: Consumer spending / retail signal: articulates REI's private-label value proposition relative to name-brand competitors in the outdoor gear category.
insights.quote: You get 90 percent of the designer item for 70 percent of the price.
insights.locator: REI Co-op Flexlite Air Chair section
